The Crew Celebrates Builder Covegiving Day / The Crew Builds a Rocket Ship Ride. Speed Meister sabotages the holiday feast in 'The Crew Celebrates Builder Covegiving Day', then in 'The Crew Builds A Rocket Ship Ride', Mix is surprised with a new ride.
Crabby Wedding / The Cloud Kingdom. Dora recovers a ring for a crab wedding in 'Crabby Wedding', then in 'The Cloud Kingdom', Dora travels to the Cloud Kingdom with Vicky the Vicuna. (S2, ep 5).

Partly Claudia / Ranita's Magic Stripes. Dora and Boots take Claudia, an energetic young rain cloud, to rain on a dry water slide. / Boots gets a case of Tickle Tail that Ranita the Frog can cure if she gets her magic stripes by helping...

Barbabravo Is Not Feeling Well / Be Patient Barbabravo.... Following a misadventure, Barbabravo is unable to transform at all. The whole family unites to help him. Barbabravo can't stay put and is unable to focus one an activity for very long.

The Seven Foods / The Perfect Portrait. The Barbababies think their food can make them change colours and shapes. They decide to find the right food for each of them. // Barbabeau lacks inspiration, he can't create anymore.

Moving Mission / Barbabright's Invention. During a walk, the Barbapapa family discovers a megalith in 'Moving Mission', and in 'Barbabright's Invention', Barbabright has a stroke of genius – the invention of the "BAM".

Princess For A Day / Barbabeau's Adventure. Barbabelle proudly announces to her family that she wants to become a princess. Barbabravo is moping with boredom, his brothers and sisters are all busy and no one wants to play with him.

Summer Camp I / Summer Camp II. Barbapapa and Barbamama have announced to their dear barbababies that they are going on a trip to Easter Island. // The Barbababies, the twins, and Mr. Strict set sail on "Thésée", a magnificent...

The Crew Builds A Firefighter Training Center / The Crew Builds A Sierra Sparkle Space Show. Builder Cove gets a new Fire Captain in 'The Crew Builds A Firefighter Training Centre', and in 'The Crew Builds A Sierra Sparkle Space Show', Charger inspires Sierra Sparkle's show.

The Crew Builds A Giant Duck Plane / The Crew Builds A Vet Room For Motor. The pups help lead migrating ducks south when 'The Crew Builds A Giant Duck Plane', then in 'The Crew Builds A Vet Room For Motor', Motor refuses to visit Dr. Diwa.

Pups Save a High Flying Hen/Pups Save a Sloth. Chickaletta takes flight on a toy plane in 'Pups Save a High-Flying Hen', then in 'Pups Save a Sloth', Mayor Humdinger mistakes a sloth for a monkey, and races the Paw Patrol to find it. (S10, ep 2).

Pups Save a Windswept Polar Bear Cub / Pups Save a Drive-in. A storm sends a polar bear cub to Adventure Bay in 'Pups Save a Windswept Polar Bear Cub', and in 'Pups Save a Drive-In', the pups must save Mayor Humdinger from a runaway movie projector. (S10, ep 4).
Switcheroo / Protect the Egg. Switcheroo: Professor Scratch's Switcheroo device causes chaos when Sir Steel uses it to get Deer Squad's Powers.(S1, ep 9a).

Magenta's Case of the Giggles. Josh and Blue are pretending to be doctors around the house, giving silly checkups to friends, but one "patient" seems to have a curious condition. We'll play Blue's Clues to help find the cure!

Walky Talky / Brothers / Blob Monster. Tim tries to return a lost walky talky to it's owner. Tim and Tommy go on a camping trip, but soon disagree on what to do first. When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.

The Crew Builds A Giant Rock-Climbing Wall / The Crew Builds A Giant Octo-Sandbox. The Crew put their vehicles to good use in 'The Crew Builds A Giant Rock-Climbing Wall', then in 'The Crew Builds A Giant Octo-Sandbox', the pups build an octopus sandbox.

Tomás's Birthday Surprise / Family Treasure Hunt. Treacherous waters are traversed in 'Tomas's Birthday Surprise', and then in 'Family Treasure Hunt', everyone pairs up to find the fabled treasure of La Caverna Secreta. (S1, ep 16).

Dora & Diego Rescue Baby Jaguar / Diego's Awesome Owl Adventure. A baby jaguar gets lost in the rainforest in 'Dora & Diego Rescue Baby Jaguar', then in 'Diego's Awesome Owl Adventure', Dora, Boots, and Diego help a baby find its parents and get home.

Return of the Thinking Squad. Return of the Thinking Squad: The Thinking Squad needs your help to find all three clues to figure out how to stop the dastardly Villain Ice before he freezes Super City. (S4, ep 17).
Cluc Croc / One Tree Home. Mr. Crocodile joins gymnastics club because Daisy loves it. Mr. Crocodile and Daisy help Gigi and Roland find separate homes when they don't want to share a tree anymore.

Living Together / Holey the Snowman. The Barbababies take the train and sleep in a hotel in 'Living Together', then in 'Holey The Snowman', Barbouille crafted a magnificent snowman that the children named Bobo.

The Mountain Eater / The First Day Of School. Barbapapa tells the Barbababies about his extraordinary encounter with a wolf in 'The Mountain Eater', then in 'The First Day Of School', tomorrow is the Barbababies' first day of school.
